    The Euler form of a directing module #

    For 0 → K → P → Z → 0 with P Euler-projective and every extension of Z by W split, ⟨dim Z, dim W⟩ = dim Hom(Z, W) + dim Hom(K, W) - ⟨dim K, dim W⟩ (euler_step). Finite products (FDMod.pi) keep Euler-projectivity (EulerProj.pi) and depth bounds (LivesBelow.pi), and extensions split summand by summand (extVanish_pi).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.euler_step {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] (D : DirData k A) {P K Z W : FDMod k A} (hP : EulerProj D P) (f : K.carrier →ₗ[A] P.carrier) (g : P.carrier →ₗ[A] Z.carrier) (hf : Function.Injective ⇑f) (hg : Function.Surjective ⇑g) (hex : f.range = g.ker) (hv : ExtVanish Z W) :
    euler D (dimZ D Z) (dimZ D W) = ↑(Module.finrank k (Z.carrier →ₗ[A] W.carrier)) + ↑(Module.finrank k (K.carrier →ₗ[A] W.carrier)) - euler D (dimZ D K) (dimZ D W)
